canonical.title: A weekend in Zwolle around a Michelin dinner

children.title: Things to do in Zwolle
children.summary: Star-shaped old town, Museum de Fundatie, canal boat, the bookshop-in-a-church, and easy Hanseatic day trips.

children.title: Michelin 2 and 3-star restaurants in Zwolle
children.summary: Zwolle proper has one starred pick — De Librije (3★). The nearest 2★ options sit 30–55 km away.

children.title: IT conferences and tech events in Zwolle
children.summary: Two recurring developer meetups, a Windesheim student showcase, and the Spoorzone/Perron038 hub running 4+ knowledge events in June 2026.
